Flying Snake.desc: A fast, tiny flyer. As a Wild Shape it needs Druid level 8 (no flying speed before then); it's also a Find Familiar option.
Flying Snake._why: SRD 5.1: the poison damage has no saving throw. The old note called it a level 2 Wild Shape, but flying forms need level 8.
